bp.name: bp
bp.tip: Lips together, then open with no puff of air — like the p in “spin”.

ph.name: ph
ph.tip: Lips together, then open with a puff of air — like the p in “pin”.

b.name: b
b.tip: Lips together, voice on, then open — like English b.

m.name: m
m.tip: Lips together and hum: the air goes out through the nose.

f.name: f
f.tip: Top teeth resting on the lower lip, and blow.

w.name: w
w.tip: Round the lips and lift the back of the tongue, then slide into the vowel.

dt.name: dt
dt.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind the top teeth; let go with no puff — like the t in “stop”.

th.name: th
th.thai: ท ถ ธ ฐ ฑ ฒ
th.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge, let go with a puff of air — the t in “top”, not the th in “thin”.

d.name: d
d.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge behind the top teeth, voice on — like English d.

n.name: n
n.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge and hum: the air goes out through the nose.

s.name: s
s.thai: ส ซ ศ ษ
s.tip: Tongue tip close to the ridge without touching, and hiss.

l.name: l
l.tip: Tongue tip on the ridge; the air flows out round the sides of the tongue.

r.name: r
r.tip: One quick tap of the tongue tip on the ridge. In everyday speech many Thais say l instead.

j.name: j
j.tip: Front of the tongue pressed to the roof behind the ridge; let go with no puff — between “j” and “ch”.

ch.name: ch
ch.tip: Front of the tongue on the roof, let go with a puff of air — like “church”.

y.name: y
y.tip: Front of the tongue up close to the roof, like the y in “yes”.

g.name: g
g.tip: Back of the tongue against the soft palate; let go with no puff — like the k in “skin”.

kh.name: kh
kh.tip: Back of the tongue against the soft palate, let go with a puff of air — like the k in “kin”.

ng.name: ng
ng.tip: Back of the tongue on the soft palate and hum through the nose — the ng of “sing”, here at the start too.

ʔ.name: (catch)
ʔ.tip: A tiny catch in the throat before the vowel — the silent อ starts it.

h.name: h
h.tip: Throat open; just breathe out, like English h.

p_.name: -p
p_.thai: บ ป พ ฟ ภ (at the end)
p_.tip: At the end: close the lips and hold. Don't let the air out.

t_.name: -t
t_.thai: ด ต ท ส จ ช … (at the end)
t_.tip: At the end: tongue tip on the ridge and hold. No release.

k_.name: -k
k_.thai: ก ข ค (at the end)
k_.tip: At the end: back of the tongue up against the soft palate and hold. No release.

a.name: a
a.tip: Mouth open, tongue low and relaxed. Short: cut it off.

aa.name: aa
aa.tip: Mouth open, tongue low and relaxed. Long: hold it twice as long.

i.name: i
i.tip: Lips spread, tongue high at the front — like “see”. Short: cut it off.

ii.name: ii
ii.tip: Lips spread, tongue high at the front — like “see”. Long: hold it twice as long.

ʉ.name: ʉ
ʉ.tip: Lips spread as for i, but the tongue pulled up at the back — “oo” without rounding the lips. Short: cut it off.

ʉʉ.name: ʉʉ
ʉʉ.tip: Lips spread as for i, but the tongue pulled up at the back — “oo” without rounding the lips. Long: hold it twice as long.

u.name: u
u.tip: Lips rounded, tongue high at the back — like “food”. Short: cut it off.

uu.name: uu
uu.tip: Lips rounded, tongue high at the back — like “food”. Long: hold it twice as long.

e.name: e
e.tip: Lips spread, tongue half-high at the front — “day” without the glide. Short: cut it off.

ee.name: ee
ee.tip: Lips spread, tongue half-high at the front — “day” without the glide. Long: hold it twice as long.

ɛ.name: ɛ
ɛ.tip: Mouth wider, tongue low at the front — like “cat”. Short: cut it off.

ɛɛ.name: ɛɛ
ɛɛ.tip: Mouth wider, tongue low at the front — like “cat”. Long: hold it twice as long.

o.name: o
o.tip: Lips rounded, tongue half-high at the back — “go” without the glide. Short: cut it off.

oo.name: oo
oo.tip: Lips rounded, tongue half-high at the back — “go” without the glide. Long: hold it twice as long.

ɔ.name: ɔ
ɔ.tip: Lips open and rounded, jaw low — like “law”. Short: cut it off.

ɔɔ.name: ɔɔ
ɔɔ.tip: Lips open and rounded, jaw low — like “law”. Long: hold it twice as long.

ə.name: ə
ə.tip: Lips relaxed, tongue in the middle — “er” with no r. Short: cut it off.

əə.name: əə
əə.tip: Lips relaxed, tongue in the middle — “er” with no r. Long: hold it twice as long.

ia.name: ia
ia.tip: Start at i (lips spread, tongue high and forward), then let the tongue drop to a short “a”.

ʉa.name: ʉa
ʉa.tip: Start at ʉ (lips spread, tongue high and back), then let the tongue drop to a short “a”.

ua.name: ua
ua.tip: Start at u (lips rounded, tongue high and back), then open to a short “a”.
